subject: general
question: Which group of companies was named the principal sponsor for Team India at the Paris Olympics 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Adani Group** was named the principal sponsor for **Team India** at the **Paris Olympics 2024**.
 
• The **Adani Group** is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in **Ahmedabad, Gujarat**.
 
• It was founded by **Gautam Adani** in 1988.
 
• The group has diverse business interests, including **energy, resources, logistics, agribusiness, real estate, financial services, and defense.**
 
• The Adani Group has a significant presence in the **ports and logistics sector** through its subsidiary, **Adani Ports and SEZ Limited**.
 
• This sponsorship aligns with the Adani Group's commitment to **supporting sports and athletes** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Puma**__

 __
 
• Puma is a leading German multinational corporation that designs and manufactures **athletic and casual footwear, apparel and accessories.**
 
• The company was founded in **1948 by Rudolf Dassler**.
 
• Puma is known for its sponsorship deals with various **sports teams and athletes** globally.
 
 
 
• **Reliance**__
 __
 
• Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) is an Indian multinational conglomerate company headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• It was founded by **Dhirubhai Ambani** in 1960.
 
• Reliance's businesses include **energy, petrochemicals, textiles, natural resources, retail, and telecommunications.**
 
 
 
• **Aditya Birla**__
 
 
• Aditya Birla Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in **Worli, Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• The group was founded by **Seth Shiv Narayan Birla** in 1857.
 
• Its businesses include **viscose staple fiber, metals, cement, textiles, carbon black, telecom, and financial services.**
